papers.title: Distance-Aware Inverse Reinforcement Learning Dataset for Robotic Grasping
papers.summary: This dataset contains state-action observations collected from a low-cost robotic manipulator during expert-guided demonstrations for robotic grasping. Each observation records four joint measurements, the scanning-servo angle of the time-of-flight (ToF) distance sensor, the measured distance between the robot and the target object, and the corresponding action label. The dataset is intended to support research on inverse reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, robotic action selection, and resource-constrained autonomous robotic grasping.

papers.title: Physical AI for Oncology Clinical Trials
papers.summary: Practical tools for integrating physical AI into oncology clinical trials. Provides production-ready configurations, validated pipelines, and integration guides for deploying robotic systems, digital twins, and embodied AI agents in oncology. Covers NVIDIA Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, ORBIT-Surgical, dVRK, and agentic/generative AI frameworks.

papers.title: Awesome Embodied AI & Sim2Real: A Living Evidence Map for ROS 2, VLA, and Sim2Real

papers.title: RL-ABC: Reinforcement learning for accelerator beamline control
papers.summary: Particle accelerator beamline optimization is a high-dimensional control problem traditionally requiring significant expert intervention. We present RLABC (Reinforcement Learning for Accelerator Beamline Control), an open-source Python framework that automatically transforms standard Elegant beamline configurations into reinforcement learning environments. RLABC integrates with the widely-used Elegant beam dynamics simulation code via SDDS-based interfaces, enabling researchers to apply modern RL algorithms to beamline optimization with minimal RL-specific development.
